items.title: EBITDA Quality Driver Tree
items: Revenue quality -> retention, expansion, pricing discipline
Gross margin -> COGS variance, supplier mix, service utilization
Operating leverage -> hiring plan, support load, automation rate
Working capital -> DSO, DPO, inventory days

items.title: Cash Conversion Driver Tree
items: DSO -> invoice accuracy, payment terms, collection backlog
DIO -> stock turns, supplier lead time, forecast error
DPO -> payment policy, supplier terms, cash discount tradeoff
